title: The Balam Reserve
description: A luxury Caribbean destination in northern Belize, presenting a 9,500-acre masterplan that brings hospitality, residences, and a protected Art & Nature Park together.
challenge: Present a destination vision at an exceptional scale while making its hospitality, residential, and conservation plans clear and easy to explore. The website also needed to distinguish the masterplan vision from project information that remains preliminary.
solution: Created a destination website introducing Balam Reserve's 9,500-acre vision on the Caribbean coast of northern Belize. The experience presents 2,500 acres planned for development alongside 7,000 conservation acres, with dedicated sections for the masterplan, Art & Nature Park, sustainability, and investment information.
results: Presented the 9,500-acre destination vision and its 4.1-mile Caribbean coastline
Explained the planned balance of 2,500 development acres and 7,000 conservation acres
Organized masterplan, Art & Nature Park, sustainability, and investment information into dedicated sections
Made project inquiries easy to find for qualified visitors
